summary: A 1930 metal ground cabin on Pollock Mountain in the Payette National Forest, staffed annually; the Forest Service trailhead page shows no trailhead closure.

access.note: The Forest Service Pollock Trailhead page (last updated May 28, 2026) shows no featured alerts and no closure for the trailhead itself. Its 'temporarily closed until further notice' line is the New Meadows Ranger District office hours, not the trailhead. Season June-October, depending on snow levels. No separate closure notice for the tower was found.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in per Idaho Fire Lookouts. The trailhead is about seven miles along Smokey Boulder Road, Forest Service Road 074. Nearby trails listed include Pollock Mountain/Cow Camp Trail #179. Check with the New Meadows Ranger District before any trip.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: An earlier reading took the Forest Service page's 'temporarily closed until further notice' line as a trailhead closure. That line is the New Meadows Ranger District office hours. The trailhead section of the page shows no closure and no featured alerts, and the Idaho Fire Lookouts page gives no closure. The record uses public access, and the story says the page shows no trailhead closure.

The register gives 8,053 ft (2,455 m). firelookout.com gives 8048 ft and the Forest Service trailhead page says approximately 8,100 feet. The record keeps the register's 2454.6 m. The story does not give an elevation.

notes_for_editor: Trailhead status: the Forest Service page (last updated May 28, 2026) shows no trailhead closure and no featured alerts. An earlier reading took its 'temporarily closed until further notice' line as a trailhead closure; that line is the New Meadows Ranger District office hours. Access is recorded as public on that basis, so a human may want to phone the district to confirm trailhead conditions. The 1917 item on the Forest Lookouts site may or may not refer to this tower, so it is kept out of the story. Elevation differs slightly across sources (2,455 m register, 8,048 ft and about 8,100 ft elsewhere). The brief's record (1930 built, standing, 2454.6 m, USFS Payette agency) checks out. Staffing is known through the 2025 Idaho Fire Lookouts entry. Web searches used: 2. Distinct pages read: 6. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the trailhead-closed claim and the do-not-head-up advice that followed from it were removed; the summit now cites the Idaho Fire Lookouts page as well as the Forest Lookouts page.
